inputs.text: He’s right to be disappointed: the US withdrawing from the Paris Agreement for a second time under the Donald Trump administration weakens the cooperation needed to confront a crisis that hits vulnerable communities hardest. The contrast is stark—the US and China helped build the unity behind the agreement, yet political choices can undo that work and put short-term interests ahead of shared responsibility.🌱
